newsitem.title: USA: Colorado Republican wins Senate contest--TV.
newsitem.headline: Colorado Republican wins Senate contest--TV.

text.p: Republican Wayne Allard won Colorado's Senate seat over Democrat Tom Strickland in one of the most hotly contested of this year's 34 Senate races, the ABC television network reported Tuesday.

Allard, a veterinarian, bested Strickland, a corporate lawyer. The Colorado seat was one Democrats had hoped to win when Republican Sen. Hank Brown retired this year after one term. The win helped Republicans to hold onto control of the Senate.
